name: meshy
description: Generate, texture, rig, animate and 3D-print models with Meshy AI through Meshy's first-party MCP server (pinned @meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server@0.6.4 over npx stdio), with a meshy-3d workflow skill bundled. Credit-spending calls ask for approval first. In Hermes Desktop: inline three.js 3D cards, a model gallery and a credit chip.

api_key.label: Meshy API key
api_key.description: From meshy.ai → API. Saving it restarts the Meshy tools with the new key.

show_credits.label: Credit balance in the status bar
show_credits.description: Desktop: show remaining Meshy credits in the status bar.

inline_viewer.label: Inline 3D cards in chat
inline_viewer.description: Desktop: render ::meshy-model replies as interactive 3D cards. Off shows them as text.

auto_rotate.label: Auto-rotate in the gallery
auto_rotate.description: Desktop: slowly spin the model in the gallery viewer.

gallery_limit.label: Recent generations shown
gallery_limit.description: How many recent Meshy generations the gallery lists (1-60).
